attributes.title: Psychotherapy Networker Symposium 2027
attributes.summary:
The 2027 Psychotherapy Networker Symposium takes place March 18 to 21, 2027, at the Omni Shoreham Hotel in Washington, DC, with a four-day virtual pass for those who cannot travel.

At the time of our check the in-person pass was offered at $829.99 instead of the listed $1,399.99, and the virtual pass at $299.99 instead of $499.99; the organizer advertises a full refund on cancellation. CE is included in the registration price.

The organizer's CE page says the 2027 Symposium is designed for counselors, social workers, psychologists, marriage and family therapists and addiction counselors, and that it anticipates offering credit in the states it lists. The exact number of CE hours per profession is not published yet, so check your state on the organizer's CE page.
